title: BlockPass
tagline: Web3 event ticketing platform with NFT tickets and anti-resale verification.
description: BlockPass is a blockchain-powered digital event ticketing platform that mints each ticket as a unique NFT, ensuring authenticity, ownership transparency, and protection against scalping or unauthorized resale. It combines Web3 security with a seamless, user-friendly experience for both attendees and organizers.
how_its_made:
Tech Stack:
	•	Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Framer Motion for a responsive, glassmorphic UI with smooth animations.
	•	Backend: Node.js and Express with MongoDB for event, user, and ticket management; JWT-based authentication for secure API access.
	•	Blockchain: Solidity smart contracts (ERC-721 standard) deployed via Hardhat on the Polygon Amoy Testnet, integrated using Ethers.js.
	•	Integration: MetaMask wallet connection, QR-based ticket validation at entry, and Email-OTP authentication to link digital identity with wallet ownership.
